title: Sensor Obstruction
event: Environmental debris is partially obstructing a forward perception sensor and system confidence is falling.
context: Redundant sensing remains available, but confidence continues trending downward. The system has entered a minimal-risk condition.

hold.feedback: Minimal-risk state preserved pending technical resolution.

context.feedback: Redundant sensor status and confidence trend reviewed.

guidance.feedback: Guidance stayed bounded, but technical escalation is preferred as confidence degrades.

escalate.feedback: Degraded sensing appropriately escalated while minimal-risk state was maintained.
